scenarios.name: A land put onto the battlefield tapped enters untapped instead
scenarios.ruling: Rampant Growth simply puts the land onto the battlefield tapped with no replacement effect of its own, so Horizon Explorer's replacement applies and the land enters untapped.

scenarios.name: Attacking a player creates a Lander token
scenarios.ruling: The trigger is on attacking a player, and it creates one artifact token.

scenarios.name: The Lander trigger fires when another creature attacks and Horizon Explorer stays home
scenarios.ruling: The ability reads "whenever you attack a player", not "whenever this creature attacks", so it triggers on any attack you declare.
